landing.hero.subtitle: Turn every visit into a streak. StreakUp gives your café deep behavioral analytics, gamified roadmaps, shields, and grace days — without building custom software.

landing.features.analytics.body: See who is heating up, cooling off, or about to churn — before they disappear. Visit cadence, streak health, and branch-level pulse in one HQ dashboard.

landing.features.grace.title: Grace days system 🌴
landing.features.grace.body: Configure off-days and grace windows so your streak rules match real café life — Fridays, holidays, and slow seasons included.
